column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 10 (M23010): Igla mundur, Lentine ditahan atasan, korban Mokosh.
# Tetap Inggris: Igla, Lentine, Kenny, Krassov, Lisa, Klukai, Voymastina, Vasily, Asteria,
# Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Squad 404, Oathguards, Leafcutter Brigade, Doll,
# Frame, P.M.C., Yellow Zone, Collapse Storm.
(During the engagement with Voymastina, the support team originally located not far behind Igla had been destroyed one by one.)
column2: (Selama bentrokan dengan Voymastina, tim pendukung yang semula berada tak jauh di belakang Igla dihancurkan satu per satu.)

column1: (The battlefield, divided into multiple modules, uses powerful combat squads as the core for pushing forward. Employing tactics of encirclement and defeating them one by one, the heavy assault squads originally scattered around Igla are cleared out.)
column2: (Medan tempur yang terbelah jadi beberapa bagian itu memakai regu tempur kuat sebagai inti pendorong. Dengan taktik mengepung dan menghabisi satu per satu, regu serbu berat yang semula tersebar di sekitar Igla dibersihkan.)

column1: (Dodging another attack wave coming from the side, Igla surveys the battlefield and instinctively attempts to contact the forces she leads.)
column2: (Sambil mengelak dari satu lagi gelombang serangan yang datang dari samping, Igla menyapu pandangan ke medan tempur dan naluriah berusaha menghubungi pasukan yang dipimpinnya.)

column1: (Frame damage exceeds 30%.)
column2: (Kerusakan Frame melampaui 30%.)

column1: (Affiliated squad... lost contact. Have they already been taken out by the enemy?)
column2: (Regu afiliasi... hilang kontak. Apakah mereka sudah dihabisi musuh?)

column1: (Exceeded originally estimated loss ratio... win rate is significantly decreasing.)
column2: (Melampaui rasio kerugian yang semula diperkirakan... peluang menang turun drastis.)

column1: (The order is to break through the enemy's defense at the fastest speed and conduct a decapitation operation on target {}.)
column2: (Perintahnya adalah menembus pertahanan musuh secepat mungkin dan melancarkan operasi pemenggalan terhadap sasaran {}.)

column1: (According to the current situation... the probability of operation failure is... 89%.)
column2: (Berdasarkan situasi saat ini... kemungkinan operasi gagal adalah... 89%.)

column1: (Igla, who was originally still wrestling with Voymastina, suddenly leaped backward and then quickly retreated.)
column2: (Igla yang semula masih bergulat dengan Voymastina tiba-tiba melompat mundur lalu cepat menarik diri.)

column1: Commander, the third-generation Doll has evacuated. Do we need to pursue?
column2: Komandan, Doll generasi ketiga sudah menyingkir. Perlu dikejar?

column1: Do not pursue a desperate enemy. I need you to maintain your combat strength to execute the next mission.
column2: Jangan kejar musuh yang terdesak. Aku butuh kalian menjaga kekuatan tempur untuk menjalankan misi berikutnya.

column1: Just forcing her back is enough.
column2: Cukup memaksanya mundur saja.

column1: (Facing the encirclement, Igla's gaze swept over everyone. Dodging attacks and retreating quickly, after breaking through the encirclement, Igla retreated to the rear without a trace of hesitation.)
column2: (Menghadapi kepungan itu, pandangan Igla menyapu semua orang. Mengelak serangan dan mundur cepat, setelah menembus kepungan, Igla menarik diri ke belakang tanpa sedikit pun ragu.)

column1: (Klukai led Squad 404 in a rapid assault, forcing back the enemy's mobile troops and ensuring the survival of the front line.)
column2: (Klukai memimpin Squad 404 dalam serbuan kilat, memukul mundur pasukan bergerak musuh dan memastikan garis depan bertahan.)

column1: (Meanwhile, in Mangi Security's temporary command room.)
column2: (Sementara itu, di ruang komando sementara Mangi Security.)

column1: (Lentine's tone was no longer as composed as before, but perhaps due to the pressure from the person she was talking to, she could only try her best to restrain her anger and anxiety.)
column2: (Nada Lentine tak lagi setenang tadi, tapi mungkin karena tekanan dari lawan bicaranya, dia cuma bisa berusaha keras menahan amarah dan kegelisahannya.)

column1: I don't understand, now is the best time to launch the third wave of attacks! The enemy's recovery speed is not that fast. As long as we act immediately, we can completely tear open Mokosh's defense gap and break into Mokosh in one go!
column2: Saya tidak paham, sekarang adalah waktu terbaik melancarkan gelombang serangan ketiga! Kecepatan pemulihan musuh tidak secepat itu. Asal kita bergerak sekarang, kita bisa merobek total celah pertahanan Mokosh dan menyerbu masuk sekaligus!

column1: The casualty rate of the Dolls is not important. Our main armored forces and that heavy firepower weapon have not been deployed.
column2: Angka korban Doll tidak penting. Pasukan lapis baja utama kita dan senjata daya tembak berat itu belum dikerahkan.

column1: Please believe me, I will personally lead the next batch of battles, and we will definitely be able to take down Mokosh within two days.
column2: Percayalah pada saya, saya akan memimpin sendiri gelombang pertempuran berikutnya, dan kami pasti bisa merebut Mokosh dalam dua hari.

column1: (However, the man on the communication screen just dropped the words 'This is an order' and cut off the communication.)
column2: (Namun, pria di layar komunikasi itu hanya melontarkan kalimat 'Ini perintah' lalu memutus sambungan.)

column1: Damn it...
column2: Sialan...

column1: (Lentine irritably takes out the cigarettes she carries with her and takes a few deep drags before calming down.)
column2: (Dengan kesal Lentine mengeluarkan rokok yang selalu dibawanya dan mengisap dalam-dalam beberapa kali sebelum tenang.)

column1: A bunch of cowards, giving me the order to standby at a critical moment.
column2: Sekumpulan pengecut, memberiku perintah siaga di saat genting.

column1: Commander Lentine, the higher-ups mean...
column2: Komandan Lentine, maksud atasan...

column1: Hmph, those amateurs sitting in their offices acting like arm-chair generals panicked when they saw the battle damage report we submitted.
column2: Hmph, para amatir yang duduk di kantor sambil bergaya jenderal di atas kertas itu panik begitu melihat laporan kerusakan tempur yang kita kirim.

column1: The casualty rate of Igla's squad, as well as the damage rate of the optical camouflage drones at the beginning, all exceeded their imagination.
column2: Angka korban regu Igla, juga tingkat kerusakan drone kamuflase optik di awal tadi, semuanya melampaui bayangan mereka.

column1: They ordered us to stand by until the reassessment is completed.
column2: Mereka memerintahkan kita siaga sampai penilaian ulang selesai.

column1: The squad led by Igla has a damage probability exceeding 80%. This data is indeed too exaggerated.
column2: Regu pimpinan Igla punya kemungkinan kerusakan di atas 80%. Angka ini memang terlalu berlebihan.

column1: 80%? Heh... according to my original estimate, the casualty probability was 90%. The current number is already much better than expected.
column2: 80%? Heh... menurut perkiraan awalku, kemungkinan korbannya 90%. Angka sekarang justru jauh lebih baik dari dugaan.

column1: Dolls are the most expendable consumables. The Financial Conglomerate is clearly the manufacturer, yet they are still evaluating their value at this time. It's truly crazy.
column2: Doll itu barang habis pakai yang paling murah. Financial Conglomerate jelas-jelas produsennya, tapi masih sempat-sempatnya menimbang nilainya di saat begini. Benar-benar gila.

column1: Moreover, with that person in Mokosh, such data is perfectly normal.
column2: Lagi pula, dengan orang itu ada di Mokosh, angka seperti itu sangat wajar.

column1: The Financial Conglomerate won't think that way... Doll heavy armor units are expensive to build. From what Lord Krassov meant, Mangi Security should retreat moderately and wait for the military to make a move to reduce our pressure.
column2: Financial Conglomerate tidak berpikir begitu... Unit lapis baja berat Doll mahal biayanya. Dari maksud Tuan Krassov, Mangi Security sebaiknya mundur secukupnya dan menunggu militer bergerak untuk mengurangi tekanan pada kita.

column1: That old fox Krassov... using the Financial Conglomerate's armaments and then letting the military make a move, this way Mangi Security's losses will be much less.
column2: Rubah tua Krassov itu... memakai persenjataan Financial Conglomerate lalu membiarkan militer yang bergerak, dengan begitu kerugian Mangi Security jauh lebih kecil.

column1: From his standpoint, I can understand his thoughts. But...
column2: Dari posisinya, aku bisa memahami jalan pikirannya. Tapi...

column1: Hasn't he considered that the military has the same idea? Everyone doesn't want to consume their own strength, and in the end... it's only us risking our lives for nothing.
column2: Tidakkah dia berpikir militer punya pikiran yang sama? Semua orang tidak mau menghabiskan kekuatannya sendiri, dan pada akhirnya... cuma kita yang mempertaruhkan nyawa sia-sia.

column1: (Fiercely stubbing out the cigarette in her hand, Lentine's eyes were full of dissatisfaction with the current situation.)
column2: (Sambil mematikan rokoknya keras-keras, mata Lentine penuh ketidakpuasan atas keadaan sekarang.)

column1: Plus, as long as Mokosh is given time to breathe, they will have more time to prepare. I don't want to give that person any space at all.
column2: Ditambah lagi, begitu Mokosh diberi waktu bernapas, mereka punya lebih banyak waktu bersiap. Aku sama sekali tidak mau memberi orang itu ruang.

column1: If we want to defeat him, we can't leave him any tactical space. Otherwise, we'll very likely be the ones defeated.
column2: Kalau kita mau mengalahkannya, kita tidak boleh menyisakan ruang taktis sedikit pun. Kalau tidak, kitalah yang kemungkinan besar akan kalah.

column1: And I need this victory... for me, for us.
column2: Dan aku butuh kemenangan ini... untukku, untuk kita.

column1: Then what should we... do now?
column2: Lalu apa yang harus kita... lakukan sekarang?

column1: (Thinking of the serious consequences that defying superiors might cause, Lentine forcefully suppressed her anger and forced herself to accept the superiors' arrangements.)
column2: (Memikirkan akibat serius kalau membangkang atasan, Lentine menekan paksa amarahnya dan memaksa diri menerima pengaturan atasan.)

column1: Wait, wait for news from the military and Mangi Security.
column2: Tunggu, tunggu kabar dari militer dan Mangi Security.

column1: I wonder what the military is planning.
column2: Aku penasaran apa yang direncanakan militer.

column1: We are just an ordinary P.M.C. after all, all work still depends on the military's final decision.
column2: Kita ini cuma P.M.C. biasa, semua pekerjaan tetap bergantung pada keputusan akhir militer.

column1: Even if the battle results are not ideal, it's not your fault.
column2: Sekalipun hasil tempurnya tidak ideal, itu bukan salahmu.

column1: According to your initial plan, using heavy troops to tear open the enemy's defense net, we have partially achieved this goal.
column2: Menurut rencana awalmu, memakai pasukan berat untuk merobek jaring pertahanan musuh, sebagian sasaran itu sudah tercapai.

column1: At least a part of the strongholds on the outskirts of Mokosh is now under our control.
column2: Setidaknya sebagian pos di pinggiran Mokosh sekarang ada di bawah kendali kita.

column1: Later on, we can completely rely on those strongholds to counterattack the enemy's defense network.
column2: Nanti kita bisa sepenuhnya bertumpu pada pos-pos itu untuk balik menyerang jaringan pertahanan musuh.

column1: Heh, that little bit of territory is just an acceptable loss to him.
column2: Heh, wilayah sekecil itu cuma kerugian yang masih bisa dia terima.

column1: Not immediately and thoroughly tearing open the defense network and giving them time to rest will only make the subsequent breakout more troublesome.
column2: Tidak langsung merobek tuntas jaringan pertahanannya dan malah memberi mereka waktu beristirahat hanya akan membuat terobosan berikutnya makin merepotkan.

column1: Can we only wait...
column2: Apa kita cuma bisa menunggu...

column1: If the military moves out, the battle situation will change quickly. Especially the "Leafcutter Brigade"... but if it really comes to that, Mangi Security will have completely lost.
column2: Kalau militer bergerak, jalannya pertempuran akan cepat berubah. Terutama "Leafcutter Brigade"... tapi kalau sampai begitu, Mangi Security sudah kalah total.

column1: This kind of victory is meaningless to us.
column2: Kemenangan semacam itu tidak berarti apa-apa bagi kita.

column1: In addition, Mokosh cannot have too many combat reserves.
column2: Selain itu, cadangan tempur Mokosh tidak mungkin terlalu banyak.

column1: Guess what they will do... when their ammunition reserves run out?
column2: Coba tebak apa yang akan mereka lakukan... saat cadangan amunisinya habis?

column1: Negotiate or surrender, pick one of the two.
column2: Bernegosiasi atau menyerah, pilih salah satu.

column1: That's right.
column2: Betul.

column1: I guess the higher-ups are waiting with that exact thought in mind.
column2: Kurasa atasan menunggu dengan pikiran persis seperti itu.

column1: But our people can't afford to wait. The thousands of brothers we brought this time... are all throwing their lives into the fire pit.
column2: Tapi orang-orang kita tidak sanggup menunggu. Ribuan saudara yang kita bawa kali ini... semuanya melemparkan nyawa ke lubang api.

column1: Forget it, since things have come to this, there's no use talking about it.
column2: Sudahlah, kalau sudah begini, percuma dibahas.

column1: Kenny, have our people ready at all times. Take advantage of the rest time to find a way to repair Igla's Frame, we still need her power.
column2: Kenny, siapkan orang-orang kita setiap saat. Manfaatkan waktu istirahat untuk mencari cara memperbaiki Frame Igla, kita masih butuh kekuatannya.

column1: Whether it's the military or Mokosh... we need to prepare contingency plans for any movements.
column2: Entah militer maupun Mokosh... kita perlu menyiapkan rencana cadangan untuk gerakan apa pun.

column1: Notify Lisa to speed up the logistics team, be ready to respond at any time, and prepare more contingency plans to ensure the stability of supplies.
column2: Beritahu Lisa untuk mempercepat tim logistik, siap merespons kapan saja, dan siapkan lebih banyak rencana cadangan demi menjamin kestabilan pasokan.

column1: Right now, there are many problems with the organization of Mangi Security's logistics formation, handle it as soon as possible.
column2: Sekarang ada banyak masalah dalam penataan formasi logistik Mangi Security, tangani secepatnya.

column1: Also... submit the intelligence about the new enemy stronghold we discovered to the military.
column2: Lalu... serahkan informasi tentang markas musuh baru yang kita temukan ke militer.

column1: This... didn't we say before...
column2: Ini... bukankah kita sudah bilang...

column1: I hope this intelligence can make the military take some action. No matter how many people, as long as they act, we have a chance.
column2: Kuharap informasi ini bisa membuat militer bergerak. Berapa pun orangnya, asal mereka bertindak, kita punya peluang.

column1: Have our people set out in advance as well, and head near that stronghold. I'm guessing that place must have a powerful reserve force ready to support Mokosh at any time.
column2: Suruh orang-orang kita berangkat lebih awal juga, menuju dekat markas itu. Dugaanku di sana pasti ada kekuatan cadangan besar yang siap membantu Mokosh kapan saja.

column1: I will block off all his escape routes completely.
column2: Aku akan menutup rapat semua jalur pelariannya.

column1: Already on it. Is there anything else you need to instruct?
column2: Sudah dikerjakan. Ada perintah lain lagi?

column1: ...Find The Elmo.
column2: ...Temukan Elmo.

column1: Orders received.
column2: Perintah diterima.

column1: The enemy has retreated, we won this wave of offensive!
column2: Musuh sudah mundur, kita menang di gelombang serangan ini!

column1: What about the casualties? Hurry up and repair the defensive strongholds, the enemy's next wave of attacks could come at any time.
column2: Bagaimana korbannya? Cepat perbaiki pos pertahanan, gelombang serangan musuh berikutnya bisa datang kapan saja.

column1: Currently tallying... the situation is not very optimistic.
column2: Sedang dihitung... situasinya tidak terlalu menggembirakan.

column1: (The initially excited words were swallowed by the attrition of war. Vasily and I stood in the temporary command room, listening to one battle report after another.)
column2: (Kata-kata yang semula bersemangat itu ditelan gesekan perang. Aku dan Vasily berdiri di ruang komando sementara, mendengarkan satu demi satu laporan tempur.)

column1: (Even though we had prepared ourselves, actually seeing the data still made everyone's heart sink.)
column2: (Meski kami sudah menyiapkan diri, melihat langsung angkanya tetap membuat hati semua orang mencelos.)

column1: (Although casualties have been noticeably controlled after the Doll squads' support, and the official report is still being compiled, according to real-time reports, the number of casualties among the Mokosh Oathguards has exceeded 180 since the conflict began. While most of them are wounded, this number is still shocking.)
column2: (Meski korban jelas bisa ditekan setelah bantuan regu Doll, dan laporan resminya masih disusun, menurut laporan langsung, jumlah korban di kalangan Oathguards Mokosh sudah melewati 180 sejak konflik dimulai. Walau sebagian besar hanya luka-luka, angka ini tetap mengejutkan.)

column1: This number...
column2: Angka ini...

column1: Vasily, can the logistics forces still keep up?
column2: Vasily, apakah pasukan logistik masih sanggup?

column1: Still enough to hold on.
column2: Masih cukup untuk bertahan.

column1: With your help, we have already resisted the vanguard attack. Keep holding on, victory belongs to Mokosh.
column2: Dengan bantuanmu, kita sudah menahan serangan pendahulu mereka. Terus bertahan, kemenangan milik Mokosh.

column1: (I earnestly patted his shoulder, hoping to provide a little emotional support for this new leader.)
column2: (Kutepuk bahunya dengan sungguh-sungguh, berharap bisa memberi sedikit penopang batin bagi pemimpin baru ini.)

column1: Vasily... believe in yourself, believe in me, and believe in everyone in Mokosh.
column2: Vasily... percayalah pada dirimu, percaya padaku, dan percaya pada semua orang di Mokosh.

column1: (Looking at those names marked as "dead", Vasily was silent for a moment, slowly clenching his fists, as if struggling with some emotion in his body. For Mokosh, the current battle situation could already be considered a victory, but Vasily's brows did not relax.)
column2: (Menatap nama-nama yang ditandai "gugur" itu, Vasily terdiam sejenak, perlahan mengepalkan tinjunya, seolah bergulat dengan sesuatu di dalam dirinya. Bagi Mokosh, keadaan pertempuran saat ini sudah bisa disebut kemenangan, tapi kerut di kening Vasily tidak mengendur.)

column1: (He looked at Mokosh's digital sand table, the projection of the city as if sheltered under his body. I have no doubt that if possible, he would definitely be willing to use his own body to block all incoming storms for Mokosh.)
column2: (Dia menatap meja pasir digital Mokosh, proyeksi kota itu seakan berlindung di bawah tubuhnya. Aku yakin, kalau bisa, dia pasti rela memakai tubuhnya sendiri untuk menahan semua badai yang datang ke Mokosh.)

column1: (I sighed silently and changed the subject. The war has already begun, and the best way to reduce sacrifices is to seize victory as soon as possible.)
column2: (Kuhela napas diam-diam dan kualihkan topiknya. Perang sudah dimulai, dan cara terbaik menekan korban adalah merebut kemenangan secepat mungkin.)

column1: (As if quickly suppressing those depressed emotions, Vasily looked at me and nodded firmly.)
column2: (Seolah cepat menekan perasaan muram itu, Vasily menatapku dan mengangguk mantap.)

column1: (At night, the fierce wind carried the coarse yellow sand of the Yellow Zone, ruthlessly cutting the Frames of the two travelers like sandpaper. Even for Dolls, traveling through a Collapse Storm is not an easy task.)
column2: (Malam harinya, angin ganas membawa pasir kuning kasar Yellow Zone, menggerus Frame kedua musafir itu tanpa ampun bagai amplas. Bahkan bagi Doll, menembus Collapse Storm bukan perkara mudah.)

column1: (However, this common sense obviously did not apply to the two of them. They were silent, using the interference of the Collapse Storm to conceal their tracks, and silently advanced towards the predetermined destination.)
column2: (Namun, akal sehat itu jelas tidak berlaku bagi mereka berdua. Mereka membisu, memanfaatkan gangguan Collapse Storm untuk menyamarkan jejak, dan diam-diam melaju ke tujuan yang sudah ditentukan.)

column1: (Of course, for Asteria, this trip clearly could not be called 'pleasant'. Given the choice, she would never be willing to act as the 'driver' for this old acquaintance again.)
column2: (Tentu saja, bagi Asteria, perjalanan ini jelas tidak bisa disebut 'menyenangkan'. Kalau boleh memilih, dia tidak akan sudi jadi 'sopir' bagi kenalan lamanya ini lagi.)

column1: (Asteria reached out and touched the case on her back, took a deep breath, and then quickened her pace, hurrying towards the direction of Mokosh.)
column2: (Asteria mengulurkan tangan menyentuh koper di punggungnya, menarik napas dalam, lalu mempercepat langkah, bergegas ke arah Mokosh.)
